title: Antimicrobials Stewardship by Pharmacist
brief_summary: To study the outcome of antibiotics stewardship
raw_criteria:
inclusion criteria:

* Inpatient with infectious disease and under broad-spectrum antibiotics

exclusion criteria:

* Poor prognosis was diagnosed or received conservative therapy only.
study_population: the investigators randomly do medical chart review of patients received broad-spectrum antibiotics from their hospital systems.
